svg.title: The standardized maximum likelihood estimator at three sample sizes
svg.desc: Three exact densities of the standardized exponential rate estimator, at sample sizes five, twenty and eighty, laid over a dashed standard normal; the skew to the right shrinks as the sample grows.
svg.text: The exact sampling density of the standardized rate estimator
square root of n, times lambda hat over lambda minus one
dashed: the limit, a standard normal
Every curve is exact rather than simulated: the estimator is n over a gamma total, with a closed-form density.
The mean of each curve is the standardized bias, root n over n minus one: 0.559 at n = 5, 0.235 at n = 20, 0.113 at n = 80.
It shrinks toward zero, but at n = 5 the curve still sits more than half a standard deviation right of the limit.
